transcript.text: I am preparing the photo. Then I will check the drawing and build its physical scene.
I am checking your drawing. You can say cancel while it builds, and I will ask if I need a detail from you.

Your drawing has become a validated 3D scene. I am starting the experiment automatically.
Ball: Ball drawn above the upper part of the ramp; placed at rest touching the sloping face.
Fixed trapezoidal ramp wedge: Ramp and its solid support are represented as one fixed trapezoidal prism with a sloping top, as clarified.
Fixed open cup: Open cup drawn beyond the ramp in the ball's path; its inside opening and height use the clarified estimates.
Horizontal floor: Assumed part. Rigid horizontal floor added to support the fixed wedge and cup.
The cup is positioned just beyond the ramp exit. The initial rolling path may strike its near wall, as specified; the drawing and dimensions do not imply that the ball enters the opening.
The stated 1.6 m ramp length is measured along its sloping surface. With a 1.0 m high end and a 0.3 m exit, its horizontal run is approximately 1.439 m.
The wedge is a rigid trapezoidal prism whose top is the ramp surface; it is fixed to the floor. Its depth is 0.5 m.
The ball is a uniform solid sphere of diameter 0.10 m, initially at rest and placed in contact with the upper ramp surface.
The cup's 0.5 m opening and 0.5 m depth are interpreted as interior dimensions. Wall and bottom thickness are assumed to be 0.02 m, giving 0.54 m external width and depth.
The cup is fixed on the floor, immediately beyond the ramp exit with a 0.05 m gap. A collision with its near wall is intentional and entry into the cup is not guaranteed.
Masses and contact coefficients are estimates, not measured: ball 0.5 kg, wedge 10 kg, cup 0.5 kg; friction and restitution are declared per object. The floor is an ideal rigid platform. No powered motion or air effects are assumed.
Your drawing is now a running 3D experiment. Tell me which part to move or what to change. I will explain edits and wait for your yes before applying them. You can also say pause or save.
Saved in this browser, including the experiment, versions, baseline and runtime checkpoint. It will reopen paused.
